_note: Craig's own calls on a player's preferred positions, main first, applied to every season of his over data/source/positions.json by scripts/build-data.py: a list replaces his positions, {"add": [...]} adds these as preferred positions after his main one in every season, {"remove": [...]} takes these out of every season. A list is final: the wide-player pairing in build-data.py leaves it alone. Keyed by the player name as in positions.json.
